# Scrolling Stop

> Scrolling Stop is an open-source Chrome extension that blocks distracting websites and brings a user's focus goals back when attention drifts.

## Product

- [Home](https://scrollingstop.com/): Product overview, screenshots, and installation links.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/filipelinsduarte/scrolling-stop): Source code, tests, security policy, and contribution guide.

## Key capabilities

- Block any website the user adds to the extension.
- Show the user's own focus goals when a blocked site is opened.
- Use two five-second holds and a short arithmetic check before a two-minute site break.
- Keep goals, blocked domains, and attention statistics in the local Chrome profile.

## Trust and privacy

The extension is local-first. It does not require an account or send browsing history to a server. The public website uses Google Analytics to measure site visits.
